_about: Notes on the results files in this folder, written by the back-end session on 2026-11-21. The .jsonl files are kept exactly as recorded; this file only adds status and settings so readers (the dashboard) can tell void, rescored and superseded runs apart and keep different test designs separate. Details: design/roadmap.md and design/hermes-agent-llm-eval-plan.md.
